### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/moby (github.com/moby/moby/api)</summary>

### [`v1.56.0`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/api/v1.56.0)

#### 1.56.0

##### Changelog

- `GET /containers/json` now supports an `annotation` filter to filter containers by annotation, either by key (`annotation=key`) or by key and value (`annotation="key=value"`), similar to the existing `label` filter. [moby/moby#53538](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53538)
- `POST /containers/create` now supports `HostConfig.Umask` to set the initial umask for a Unix container. When set, the daemon includes the value in the OCI process configuration for the container's entrypoint, exec processes, and healthchecks. When omitted, the runtime's default behavior applies.[moby/moby#53463](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53463)
- api/docs: sync API docs v1.25 - v1.55. [moby/moby#53246](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53246)
- api/swagger: Align Healthcheck name with Go struct. [moby/moby#53567](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53567)
- api/types/plugin: Deprecated `plugin.Privileges` sorting methods in favor of `slices.SortFunc`. [moby/moby#53511](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53511)
- api/types/plugin: fix Privileges Swap implementation. [moby/moby#53510](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53510)
- api: Bump to 1.56. [moby/moby#53425](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53425)
- api: document Task.NetworksAttachments in the swagger definition. [moby/moby#53082](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53082)
- api: remove gotest.tools from tests. [moby/moby#53535](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53535)
- api: swagger: Use int64 for build query params. [moby/moby#53520](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53520)
- api: use blackbox testing. [moby/moby#53525](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53525)
- Fix API reference documenting an unsupported `names` filter for `GET /configs`. [moby/moby#53447](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53447)

</details>
